title: SettingsUpdatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'settings.updated'. STATE.md Addendum A (admin-configurable server settings), decision A5: emitted in the SAME transaction as every server_settings row write (packages/db/src/query/settings.ts's upsertServerSettingAndEmit) and every provider-key write/clear (A9 — packages/db/src/query/settings.ts's emitRedactedSettingsUpdated). ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring job.updated exactly: apps/server/src/gateway/ws-broadcaster.service.ts's ADMIN_ONLY_TYPES list gates this type to admin-context sockets only, since (like job.updated) it carries no item/library/user content association for packages/db/src/query/events.ts's own visibility predicate to gate on. `oldValue`/`newValue` are the literal string '[redacted]' for provider-key events (A9: a secret's value is NEVER placed in an event, logged, or returned by a status endpoint) — for every other settings key they carry the actual JSON value (whatever shape that key's registry entry declares: boolean/number/string/array/object), so `null` is reserved for 'oldValue was never previously set' and is never itself a valid settings value.

actorUserId.description: The admin who made this change, re-verified live against users.is_admin at mutation time (A10) — always a real user id, never null (unlike envelope.actorUserId's general nullability for system-originated events, a settings mutation always has a human admin actor).

key.description: The packages/shared/src/settings-registry.ts key that changed, or 'providerKey.<provider>' for an A9 provider-key set/clear.

oldValue.description: The previous value, or null if this write created the row for the first time. '[redacted]' for provider-key events (A9).

newValue.description: The value now in effect. '[redacted]' for provider-key events (A9).
